source_title: Cincinnati Open 2026 QF: Iga Swiatek On-Court Interview
zh: 对手不得不退赛总是让人非常失望。
这不是你想看到的那种胜利。
是啊，当然。
老实说，看到这个情况我都觉得焦虑。
所以我希望伊莲娜没事，显然下一站赛事是优先的。
我知道这一站也很重要，但美网就是美网，我希望她能
为此做好准备，因为她也非常接近世界第一了。
所以很遗憾，我觉得我们本来打得很好。
但健康是第一位，所以我希望她会没事，一切都会好。
我们也是，希望她会没事。
如果伊莲娜在听，我们祝你早日康复。
我们利用这个机会和你聊几分钟，
谈谈你现在的网球状态。
你似乎状态正佳，感觉很好，
走上球场时带着微笑。
你作为卫冕冠军回到网球的中心。
回到俄亥俄州梅森感觉有多特别？
是的，我感觉很棒。
我觉得已经准备好打出最佳水平，过去几周给了我很多信心。
所以我很高兴能在这里打出我喜欢的网球，享受比赛，当然这很有趣。
好的，我们要到8点30分男士们才会出场。
你和我能打一会儿单打吗，你可以帮我提高一下音量？
只是问问，我是开玩笑的。
你能帮我们签几个网球吗？
在你签之前，简单问一下，杰西卡·佩古拉，你和她打过很多次。
你对她的打法很了解。
她很坚韧，你也很坚韧。
当我们看你和杰西比赛时，会有什么看点？
嗯，她是个很棒的竞争者，我觉得我们在巡回赛上已经……
我们打过很多场比赛，都是我们状态最好的时候激烈交锋
比赛总是很艰难。
比分交替上升，很多次打到三盘。
所以我很期待这场比赛，因为对我来说这肯定会是一个挑战。
她在硬地场上有很棒的打法，是的，这肯定会是一场精彩的半决赛。
好的，祝你在半决赛中好运。
欢迎回到辛辛那提，各位，你们的卫冕冠军。
让我们给你一些签名网球。

_asr_rows.text: It's always a huge disappointment when an opponent has to retire from a match.
It's not the kind of win that you want to see.
Yeah, of course.
Honestly, I was feeling anxious just looking at this situation.
So I hope Elena will be fine and obviously the next tournament is the priority.
I know this one is important as well, but US Open is US Open and I hope she's going
to be ready for that because she's also super close to being number one in the world.
So it's a shame because I felt we were playing a good match.
But health is a priority, so I hope she's going to be okay, everything.
We do, we hope she's going to be okay.
And if Elena's listening, we do wish you a speedy recovery.
Let's take this opportunity to spend a couple of minutes with you,
talk about the kind of tennis you're playing now.
You seem that you're in a zone, you're in a good place,
you have a smile when you walk out on court.
You're back here as defending champion to the heart of tennis.
How special to be back here in Mason, Ohio?
Yeah, I feel great.
I feel ready to play my best game and the last weeks have been giving me a lot of confidence.
So I'm happy to be here playing good tennis that I like and I enjoy and for sure it's fun.
Okay, so we have not till 8.30 until the guys come out.
Can you and I play singles for a little while and you can help me with my volume?
Just got to ask, I mean, I'm kidding.
Will you sign some tennis balls for us?
Before you do, real quick, Jessica Pagula, you've played her a lot.
You know her game very well.
She's tough, you're tough.
What do we have in store when we watch you play Jessie?
Well, she's a great competitor and I feel like we've been on tour for...
We've been playing many matches where we had our best games like clashing
and it's always such a tough match.
It went both ways, many three sellers.
So I'm excited to play this match because for sure it's going to be a challenge for me.
She has a great game for hard courts and yeah, it's going to be a good semis for sure.
All right, we wish you best of luck in the semis.
Welcome back to Cincy, your defending champion, everyone.
Let's get some autographed tennis balls for you.
